label_admissibility.ADMISSIBLE: status OK and no action-shaped discontinuity in [entry, exit]
label_admissibility.DATA_BLOCKED_ACTION_WINDOW: unverified corporate-action-shaped discontinuity inside the window

pit_rules.cutoff: features read only bars with available_at <= decision T00:15 IST next local day (W1/W2 rule)
pit_rules.exit: h-session close with conservative extension (W1 engine)
pit_rules.holdout_quarantine: 2024-06-21..2026-09-17 (REVEALED_W2_HOLDOUT) is refused by the fold builder
pit_rules.imputation: none; abstaining features are named exclusions (complete-row models) or explicit NaN (HGB)
pit_rules.purge: train rows whose label exit_session reaches into the validation span minus a 10-session embargo are dropped
pit_rules.window_gate: lookbacks containing archive session-gaps or close/prev_close outside [0.65, 1.54] abstain

unavailable_features.sector_relative: no source-verified, as-of historical sector map (DATA_BLOCKED)
